content: Just as the snake perceived in a rope vanishes when the rope is properly seen with a lamp, so the world of suffering vanishes when the true Self is known.
author: Adi Shankara
explanation: Fear and psychological suffering stem from superimposed illusions (*adhyasa*). Shining the light of clear discernment reveals there was never a threat, only a misperceived reality.
practicalInsight: Examine a persistent anxiety today: is it a factual emergency or a mental 'snake' projected upon a harmless rope?
reflectionPrompt: What perceived danger in my life is merely a projection of unexamined fear?
